__DOMAIN_WHITELIST_NOTE__.description: The following domains need to be configured in WeChat Mini Program backend (mp.weixin.qq.com) for production

dev_domains.note: Development domains only - set urlCheck to false during development

configuration_guide.step_1: Login to WeChat Mini Program backend: mp.weixin.qq.com
configuration_guide.step_2: Navigate to: Development -> Development Settings -> Server Domain Configuration
configuration_guide.step_4: For production, all domains must use HTTPS (except socket which uses WSS)
configuration_guide.step_5: After configuration, restart Mini Program to apply changes

__DOMAIN_WHITELIST_NOTE__.note: Set urlCheck to false during development to bypass domain validation
